schema_note: Who to ask so a train_ok English edition could become redistribute_ok. JSON is the source of truth; corpus/rights_outreach.csv is a spreadsheet export. Hosting a scan is not a sublicense. Status/follow-up dates start empty until a human sends mail. Not a legal opinion. US jurisdiction.
ask_for_default: CC-BY or CC-BY-SA covering the English translation, for inclusion in a public Classical Arabic–English parallel research dataset (full text, commercial research use, attribution required). Not a request for NC-only.

hosts.permission_claim: Compilation copyright Ghazali.org / Ghazali Study Group. They say postings are fair use for a non-profit scholarly site, not that publishers licensed redistribution. One exception noted on the dissertations page: Davis 2005 Iqtisad translation posted 'with kind permission from the author' — that permission is to the host, not a CC grant to us.
hosts.contact: webmaster via ghazali.org (Muhammad Hozien / Ghazali Study Group)

hosts.permission_claim: Indexes now stub-redirect to muslimphilosophy.org. Old /books/*.pdf still GET. No publisher-permission statement found on the live pages. Same operator family as ghazali.org. A public PDF GET is train_ok; it is not redistribute_ok.

Homepage: 'Articles and books posted on this website have been done so with permission from the copyright holders.' Holders are not named. Takedown invite via the contact form. Their permission to host is not a sublicense to republish.

PD transcriptions (Palmer, Gairdner, Nicholson 1911, Hamadhani, Wortabet, etc.). Site compilation/HTML © 2023 John Bruno Hare unless a page is marked public domain. 20th-century items they flag 'not renewed' (Williams 1962) still need a renewal-database check before public_wuquf. Cloudflare often blocks bots; pages themselves are public GET in a browser.
hosts.contact: sacred-texts.com contact/FAQ — only relevant for their HTML markup, not for US-PD book text

hosts.permission_claim: Ahlul Bayt Digital Islamic Library Project. Books are posted as free HTML/PDF GET. Site terms are not a CC grant to republish the English. robots.txt crawl-delay 10. printpdf/book/export/html/{node} is the book-length PDF.
